description: Na₄Ti₅O₁₂ is Spinel-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with ten TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-68°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.28 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.53 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with ten TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-67°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.19 Å. There are three inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with four TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.00 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with five TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.20 Å. In the third Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with five TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.29 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with five ONaTi₃ tetrahedra, corners with six ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with five ONaTi₃ tetrahedra, corners with six ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with six ONaTi₃ tetrahedra, corners with four ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ti atoms to form distorted ONaTi₃ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONaTi₃ tetrahedra, corners with eight ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids, and edges with three ONaTi₃ tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ti atoms to form distorted ONaTi₃ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONaTi₃ tetrahedra, corners with eight ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids, and edges with three ONaTi₃ tetrahedra.
